data.title: 阿斯特蕾亚 · 草坪暖阳的羽翼遮阳伞
data.description: 绿草如茵的小镇山坡上，阿斯特蕾亚与你并肩躺在草地上。她展开两面巨大洁白的羽毛翅膀，像轻柔的毛毯般将你遮挡住刺眼的阳光，像小狗一样亲昵地蹭着你的手臂。
data.location: grassy meadow hill under wide summer sky
data.action: lying on grass side by side, wrapping large white angel wings overhead to shade partner, nuzzling arm affectionately
data.lighting: brilliant summer daylight diffused softly by translucent white feathers
data.mood: peaceful angelic devotion, supreme tenderness, warm idyllic nap
data.promptProse: Lying in a wildflower meadow, Astraea wraps her huge white wings around partner to provide shade, smiling with pure dog-like devotion.
data.animaCaption: Astraea shielding partner from the sun with large white wings on a grassy hill.
